profile_text.body:
Thomson Reuters (Nasdaq/TSX: TRI) is a publicly traded global content and technology company that describes itself as delivering technology with purpose, aimed at helping professionals in legal, tax, accounting, risk, fraud, and government sectors make faster decisions and work more efficiently. Its product portfolio spans legal research, tax and trade compliance, and risk management, with tools such as CoCounsel, Westlaw, Practical Law, and ONESOURCE+, the last of which brings tax, trade, legal, and risk functions into a single connected platform.

CoCounsel is Thomson Reuters's primary AI product for legal professionals, built on what the company calls Fiduciary-Grade AI principles and grounded in Westlaw and Practical Law content. It is designed to support legal research, analysis, drafting, and multi-step litigation workflows. The company cites a case study in which a firm called Justly Prudent used CoCounsel and Westlaw AI to increase its litigation capacity by 100%. Thomson Reuters also offers AI-powered Harmonized System code classification for trade compliance, positioned for import and export product classification. The company's 2026 AI in Professional Services Report, which draws on perspectives from more than 1,500 professionals, tracks the adoption of generative and agentic AI across professional services sectors.

The held facts confirm Thomson Reuters is a for-profit public company with SEC CIK 0001075124 and ticker TRI, verified as of August 21, 2026. CoCounsel is tracked under the Finance and Legal AI category, with noted considerations around legal research, litigation support, Westlaw integration, and attorney work product risk. No litigation or MCP server entries are recorded in the held facts at this time.
